PROFILE SUMMARY

transaction processing, custodian banking operations, and securities settlement. Currently designated as Team Leader / 
Assistant Manager at State Street Corporate Services, a premier global custodian bank, managing critical financial 
operations and supporting clients across India, APAC, EMEA and North America.

trade processing, security movement, and post-trade lifecycle management. Proficient in handling cash receipts and 
disbursements via SWIFT (MT202), foreign exchange settlements, netting, and fee-based fund transfers. Experienced in a 
wide range of financial instruments including equity, fixed income securities, mutual funds, derivatives, and money 
market instruments such as CPs, CDs, and repos. Possesses sound knowledge about the different clearinghouses like 
CREST, EUROCLEAR, DTC, FED and so on to enable securities settlement. 
• Demonstrates in-depth expertise in wealth management/financial planning platform in handling international 
customers/process. Already worked as a client facing role in one of the top custodian bank State Street Corporate 
Services and have excellent client service delivery experience. Worked in US Time zone follow client holiday calendar.

interfacing, particularly with operations and service teams across the UK and US. Possesses deep understanding of 
Regulatory Assurance, Regulatory Compliance & Regulatory Change 
• Known for identifying and mitigating operational risks, driving process standardization, supporting transitions of banking 
products within international trade, and facilitating compliance and audit reviews. Successfully formulated new policies 
and procedures, driving business growth, cost-reduction, and efficiency improvements through structured process 
redesign, resource planning, and productivity management. 
• Demonstrated success in planning and executing banking-related processes, maximizing account profitability, improving 
liquidity positions, and delivering enhanced returns. Strong experience in developing operational strategies, defining 
SLA/KPI frameworks, ensuring TAT compliance, and aligning manpower effectively to deliver seamless service. 
• Played a strategic role in client relationship management, building service standards for operational excellence, and 
leading initiatives that enhanced customer experience and retention. Recognized as a visionary professional capable of 
driving organizational transformation, developing AOPs, and contributing directly to top-line and bottom-line growth. 
• Accomplished in project management, successfully leading the entire project lifecycle from planning to delivery, while 
ensuring cost optimization, interdisciplinary coordination, and documentation compliance. Acted as a key contributor in 
multiple successful process migrations, including North American transactions, image application, and the GTM Blotter to 
TXR system transition. Served as BCP Coordinator and SharePoint Committee Representative, ensuring business 
continuity and SOP governance. 
• Renowned for implementing strong internal controls, conducting risk assessments, and executing quality audits. Excelled 
at mentoring teams, leading up to 10 professionals, facilitating performance improvement through training workshops, 
and embedding LEAN initiatives that earned multiple performance and innovation awards. 
• Notable for championing process transformation—identifying inefficiencies, redesigning workflows, and enhancing 
service delivery with measurable gains in efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Known for leading change management 
initiatives, attaining breakthrough performance levels, and enhancing operational quality standards. 
• Holds an M.Com degree along with Company Secretary Executive certification. Open to leveraging this versatile 
experience across investment operations, O2C/R2R functions, middle-office roles, fund accounting, or risk and 
compliance functions—ideally based in Mumbai or Pune, while remaining open to broader opportunities within financial 
operations and shared services environments.
